verdict.rationale: A model-hosting platform could plausibly ship a built-in assistant that takes delegated tasks, so this axis applies. The evidence only describes running, fine-tuning and deploying hosted models through an API. Hosted models with conversational editing are catalog content, not a built-in product assistant, and the pack contains no evidence of an in-product agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
